notes.title: Husbandry Update
notes.content:
The new Husbandry update is live!
This update is fully compatible with older saves.

[b]Big additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 9 animals. Animals can be gathered through expeditions. They can be bred and slaughtered for meat as well as other uses.
[*] Added critical strikes to battles.
[*] Added 6 new trackers to statistics. Animals bred total, animals top, population top, highest damage dealt in one blow, highest difficulty beaten, speedrun record.
[*] Added inspirations. Your researchers or miners can become inspired resulting in upgrades being 50% cheaper for the remainder of that day.
[*] Added quickstart option when creating a new game. If you have completed the game before you can start with some extra resources.
[/list]

[b]Small changes[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 new Achievements.
[*] Added tooltip for expedition speed.
[*] Added tooltip for town size.
[*] Renamed "Upgrades" to "More".
[*] Cleaned up the statistics screen.
[*] Changed Map upgrade from 2%(cumulative) to 5%(constant).
[/list]
